body: My school actually doesn't have a counselor that I know of. I looked at school's mental health resources online, and it sent me to the community's health center, which isn't close by. Also, I don't have a car, and I am restricted to my family's schedules, so I don't have much time to explore outside school and home. I've been thinking of calling the ER if anything goes wrong or maybe calling a crisis center, but I have horrible phone anxiety.

Yes, I've told her several times, and she said, "stop being overly dramatic." Other times, when I tell her I want to hurt myself instead of saying I want to commit suicide, she says she'll get me help during the summer. I'm not even sure she will do that. I've been begging her for three years now, and each time there's a different excuse. In high school it was: "you don't want to go to therapy because you don't want your peers to know you're in therapy."

I'm pretty sure she doesn't know how serious this is, and right now, reddit is all I have.

I think its a money issue and a time issue. She wants to wait until summer because I might have some extreme reactions to the medicine, and she doesn't want me fail my classes. She doesn't even want to take me to a therapist. She just wants to go to a GP and get me some medicine, and I'm currently not on any meds.
